status: experimental, fixed starting thresholds; no profitability or predictive validation

early_reversal.note: Previous close below previous EMA20; reclaim prior 3-bar high on volume. Does not require rising EMA20, EMA50 reclaim or old 20-bar breakout.

sideways_volume.note: Prior closed box and increasing current volume while price remains near the box. Volume alone does not establish accumulation or buy pressure.

retest.note: Only bars strictly after a closed breakout count. Same frozen anchor, real return to support, small base, lower volume than breakout and SAR below price. Broken support cannot be resurrected without a new anchor.

measurement.note: Separate experiment. One first actual quote per exchange/token, all matching groups stored; group transitions do not create independent samples. Previous V4 cohort continues separately.

threshold_policy: These choices are frozen before the broad retrospective check. No parameter search or tuning based on the three motivating winners.
